description: Spontaneous coordination among mid-level professionals in law, finance, and public administration emerges through encrypted platforms, organising work slowdowns and credential-withholding actions in protest against AI-driven de-skilling. The movement avoids physical confrontation but disrupts institutional throughput.

A shadow network of independent evaluators and former lab staff begins publishing unsanctioned model evaluations using repurposed open-weight systems, claiming to expose safety gaps in frontier models. The effort gains traction in technical communities, challenging official narratives and increasing pressure on regulators.
